summary: A two-high capsule-hotel stack: two moulded fibreglass pods (rooms 017 and 018) on a gunmetal plinth, each wi… joints pod0_hatch, pod1_hatch; options glow, shell_colour, bedding; sockets socket_sleep_lower, socket_sleep_upper, socket_ladder.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.capsule_hotel_pod or place "prefab": "capsule_hotel_pod" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d().
